corrections.why: _irdai_case/irdai_role/role_for match the desk case by correlation id; _await_move(claim, found, seen, role) waits for the desk to move before the next role
_verdict_after_reopen: a reopened case's status reply is read as the new verdict
consent answers dropped from the payload; external_id answers kept
form_answers, relation keys under plain names, diagnoses/care_team via _member

status_for: query answers and resubmissions on the submit paths (19, 131, 151/161) send x-hcx-status request.initiated with a new correlation (nhcx-docs flows claim-query-response, preauth-query-response; NHCX-1011 otherwise); RESPONSE_KINDS removed
exemption for the e2e runner (unit suite stays network-free)
query answer goes out as request.initiated

corrections.what: claim_ref: take Task/CommunicationRequest identifier values first, then the first reference value with no '/' or ':' (the literal rule picked urn:uuid references)
request_id falls back to the CommunicationRequest fullUrl's last segment; the PMJAY notification has no id
acknowledgement reuses the request bundle identifier only when it has a value; otherwise {payer_system, '<claim_no>-N<query_id>'}
corrections.source: fhir/C6 PMJAY notification has identifier without value

corrections.what: B4 example carries inResponseTo; F12 omits it and F12 was followed
workflow id map from PAYERS.md applied before the outcome/reason table; error header/error[] always wins; partial outcome keeps an approval as partial

corrections: nhcxApi.getPractitioner/updatePractitioner TRes is {ok, message, profile} (backend views_global.PractitionerProfileView), not a bare profile.
A19 actions also include 'suggestions' and 'address' (backend AbhaView) beyond the six listed in CONTRACT.md; the S14 create flow needs them to choose an ABHA address.
Backend extras used though not in CONTRACT.md: POST claims/{id}/discharge/ (S11 discharge details) and POST claims/{id}/queries/{query_id}/ack/ (S10 send acknowledgement).

corrections.what: G3 lists live.abdm.gov.in for the production sessions URL; G2/CORE give apis.abdm.gov.in/api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions. Used G2 (config is the single source of defaults).
G4 gives apis.abdm.gov.in/pmjay/hcx as production registry base; G2 gives apisprod.nha.gov.in/pmjay/hcx/participanthcxservice. Used G2.
G8D prose says an unmatched message writes no row, but the G8 pseudocode/table record it as delivered. Followed the pseudocode: every inbound is recorded (status delivered, peer.outcome=unmatched).
Inbound also accepts a flattened JWE (protected/encrypted_key/iv/ciphertext/tag) and cleartext type:ProtocolResponse bodies (payloadType protocol).
Keys starting with $comment are allowed anywhere in the config so the example file can document every key; all other unknown keys are still rejected.

In CARE the G1 background loops run as Celery beat tasks (care.nhcx.tasks.refresh_tokens every 60 s, prune_ledger hourly, check_gateway on worker_ready), only where settings.NHCX_ROLE is true. Gateway.start()/stop() keep the thread loops for hosts without Celery.

send() refuses to run inside a caller's atomic block (SendInTransactionError, a RuntimeError, not a SendError); atomic blocks opened by Django TestCase (_from_testcase) are ignored so services stay testable.

Ledger is safe across processes (gunicorn workers + celery): an fcntl lock on <dir>/.lock around id allocation and writes, and each reader refreshes its in-memory index incrementally from <day>/index.jsonl before queries.
Session tokens are also shared through Django's default cache (settings.NHCX_SHARED_TOKEN_CACHE, default true) so the refresher process warms tokens for web workers.
x-hcx-timestamp and the acceptance timestamp use the Django time zone (Asia/Kolkata in CARE) rather than the container's process zone; @hcx suffix detection is case-insensitive.
